metadata.description: Every Dolma validation-loss record from the hyperparameter sweeps behind the scaling-law fits — all (lr, wd) settings, not just the winners.

caveats.tokens_evaluated: Two validation-set sizes are present (3,478,624 and 13,279,917 tokens); losses are comparable within a set but the column is kept so mixed comparisons stay visible.
caveats.run_complete: False for runs that did not reach their final step; their val_loss is the best eval seen so far.
caveats.selected_for_scaling_fit: True when this run's (lr, wd) matches what dolma_<size>.py records for that (scale, epochs/K) — i.e. the point used in the writeup fits.
